l-m-m2-b01-01.title: Ingabe (a+b)² ihlala ilingana no-a²+b²?
l-m-m2-b01-01.goal: Hlola ukuthi isitatimende sokuthi (a+b)² ihlala ilingana no-a²+b² siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaze isimo lapho singeyona iqiniso (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-m2-b01-01.material: Isitatimende: kunoma yiziphi izinombolo ezimbili a no-b, (a+b)² ilingana no-a²+b². Thola u-a no-b abakhombisa ukuthi lesi sitatimende siphutha.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s1.r.a: (3+0)²=9 no-3²+0²=9, ngakho ayalingana. Lesi yisibonelo esifanela isitatimende.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s1.r.b: (0+5)²=25 no-0²+5²=25, ngakho ayalingana. Lesi yisibonelo esifanela isitatimende.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s1.r.d: Womabili amanani angu-0, ngakho ayalingana. Lesi yisibonelo esifanela isitatimende.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s1.explain: (2+3)²=25 kodwa 2²+3²=13. Njengoba (a+b)²=a²+2ab+b², ziyahluka noma nini lapho a×b ingeyona u-0.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: (2+3)²=25 kodwa 2²+3²=13, ngakho amanani amabili ahlukile. Ngakho a=2, b=3 kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo kusimangalo.
l-m-m2-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: Uma a=2 no-b=3, uhlangothi lwesobunxele lungu-25 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-13, ngakho aziyefani. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi isimangalo asilungile.

l-m-m2-b05-04.s.s1.o.a: I-trapezoid enezinhlangothi ezimbili ezilinganayo enezinhlangothi eziphezulu nezingezansi ezihlukile

l-m-m2-b0s5-01.title: Ingabe isamba sezinkulumo ezimbili ze-quadratic sihlala siyinkulumo ye-quadratic?
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.goal: Hlola ukuthi isisho sokuthi isamba sezinkulumo ezimbili ze-quadratic sihlala siyinkulumo ye-quadratic siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaza isimo lapho kungenjalo (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.material: Isisho: Uma wengeza izinkulumo ezimbili ze-quadratic, isamba sihlala siyinkulumo ye-quadratic naso. (Inkulumo ye-quadratic yileyo ebanga layo eliphezulu lingu-2, isb. x²+3x.) Thola ukwengeza okukhombisa ukuthi lesi sisho siyiphutha.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.r.a: Isamba u-3x²−x+1 siyinkulumo ye-quadratic nasso. Kuyisibonelo esifanelana nesisho.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.r.b: Isamba u-4x²−x+5 siyinkulumo ye-quadratic nasso. Kuyisibonelo esifanelana nesisho.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.r.d: Isamba u-2x²+2x+3 siyinkulumo ye-quadratic nasso. Kuyisibonelo esifanelana nesisho.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s1.explain: (x²+4x)+(−x²+2)=4x+2. Amathemu e-x² ayaqedana futhi umphumela uyinkulumo eqondile, ngakho isamba asiyona inkulumo ye-quadratic.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukwengeza u-x² no-−x² kunika u-0 futhi ayanyamalala, ngakho isamba u-4x+2 siyinkulumo eqondile. Lokho kwenza kube yisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-m2-b0s5-01.s.s2.model.1: Ku-(x²+4x)+(−x²+2), amathemu e-x² angeza ku-0, kunika u-4x+2, ngakho akuyona inkulumo ye-quadratic.

l-m-m2-b0s5-09.title: Ingabe i-graph yesibalo esilayini njalo ingumugqa othambekile?
l-m-m2-b0s5-09.goal: Hlola ukuthi isimangalo sokuthi i-graph yesibalo esilayini njalo ingumugqa othambekile siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese ukhomba futhi uchaza icala lapho kungeyona iqiniso (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-m2-b0s5-09.material: Isimangalo: Endizeni yezixhumanisi, i-graph yesibalo esilayini ax+by=c (a no-b akubona bobabili u-0) njalo ingumugqa ongafani ne-x-axis noma i-y-axis. Thola isibalo esibonisa ukuthi lesi simangalo asilungile.
l-m-m2-b0s5-09.s.s1.explain: x=4 ngu-1·x+0·y=4. Isixhumanisi sika-x sihlala singu-4, ngakho ngumugqa ofana ne-y-axis.
